message:
docs(update): the inline claim is true of both now, and gdi passed once

Two corrections to the record.

The "not inline" half was written when it was true of the client only, and
the host was still waiting on its UI thread. It is true of both now, and the
entry says so along with the fact that it was false for the host when first
written -- a line that was wrong for one of two places is worth leaving
visible.

And gdi_capture_process failed in one full run and passed in the next, with
nothing between them touching it. That supports the environment explanation
without proving it, so it goes in as an observation: "not always failing" is
where narrowing the cause starts.
